reviews.text: Thank you

Fantastic groomer who is very professional and does excellent work.

A huge thank you for your kindness and professionalism towards Pongo, who isn't always easy to handle. Absolutely top-notch, go there without hesitation, he's the best!

This is the second time I've gone there for my two-and-a-half-year-old Belgian Malinois. The team is always kind and attentive.
You can really tell they love animals!
I highly recommend them.

Kindness and care are the hallmarks of this salon, where staff are attentive and always offer sound advice.
Our Cocker Spaniel is pampered there; he loves being fussed over… We highly recommend them.
Excellent work! First time we went to this professional: top-notch!

I've been a customer of Pile Poil for many years.
Frédéric is very professional. My little dog (Valentin) always comes out perfectly groomed. I highly recommend this dog salon!
Very good, I recommend it.
Kudos to the whole team at Pile Poil, a super friendly and very professional grooming salon that does magnificent work!!

A huge thank you to the entire team at Pile Poils for their kindness, warm welcome, and exceptional professionalism. Our dogs are pampered there and always leave looking magnificent, proud as peacocks!
My dachshund, Gabin, loves visiting them, both for the cuddles and to see his friends, Fred's dogs (the owner). I highly recommend this place to all dog lovers. ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
Professional groomer who works with respect for animals, more than affordable rates and very good quality of work.

Very professional and welcoming! Our dog was put at ease right away, despite our Staffordshire Bull Terrier being very timid. The service was quick and very efficient. The prices are more than reasonable. The salon is beautiful and, above all, impeccably clean. I highly recommend it; I've found a superb place!

I'm a foster parent with the animal welfare association Les Ailes de la PA, and I had a little Shih Tzu who really needed a complete grooming.

I contacted Frédéric to see if he could help us, and he agreed to do it free of charge and very quickly.

The result is incredible: little Loulou is transformed! A huge thank you for your generosity, kindness, and professionalism. I highly recommend him.
I've been taking my Beagle Oreo to Pile Poils for 4 years now and I've never been disappointed! Frédéric and his team really take care of the animals.
Thank you ♥️♥️♥️♥️

I've been bringing my Spitz, Nuts, here for 8 years now and I've never been disappointed. Always top-notch, incredibly kind to the animals, and absolutely impeccable work every time. You can feel their love for their work and their respect for dogs. I recommend them without hesitation! 🐾❤️ …
Blue was very well-behaved for his first grooming experience, and I want to thank him for his outstanding work. I highly recommend this professional!

Thank you so much! I'm so happy with the result! The service was wonderful, very friendly and professional! My English Cocker Spaniel gets a great haircut and smells amazing! Kisses from Pistou, see you soon 👋🏼 …

For over six years, Pile Poils has been pampering my little Marley every month, and I wouldn't change groomers for the world!
Frédéric and his small team are incredibly gentle with our furry friends.
I wholeheartedly recommend this grooming salon!

Finally, I want to thank Frédéric immensely for his gentleness, kindness, and professionalism over all these years!
A thousand thanks from Marley & Thifany! 🥰❤️
A very warm welcome...the staff were very attentive and reassuring...I highly recommend this place...thank you for my little one!!!!
Thank you ☺️
He was useless; he cut my little dog's fur with a hair scrunchie, I won't even describe the result.
Very professional and takes good care of our dogs

The best, attentive and very professional.
Thank you.
Very kind and very professional. Very gentle with animals.
A truly great professional! My 13-year-old Gribouille was groomed for the first time. Thank you for your advice, which no one had given me before. Well done! Myriam and Gribouille

A team of highly competent and friendly professionals.
Patience and love for animals.
I recommend them a thousand times over!
Go for quality work! 😁 …

Layla was greeted by two very friendly and welcoming professionals. You can feel their genuine love for animals as soon as you walk into the salon. My little Bichon Frise immediately felt at ease.
Impeccable service at an excellent price. I highly recommend this salon.
Fantastic groomer, very attentive, who provides excellent care for my staff's skin problems due to allergies. I highly recommend him, thank you!

A groomer who has the qualities you expect from a professional working with our animals. I made an appointment based on the positive reviews on Google, and I'm so glad I did. The price wasn't excessive for the "full package" (cut, wash, treatment, ear cleaning, nail trim, and trimming between the paw pads) on my 6kg dog: €50. It was also efficient; I was able to pick her up after an hour and a half.

Here's a little before/after of my girl, who was a real mop in the wild!
Thank you for your work.
